title: Rung: thermodynamics, decoherence and horizons as recoverability flows

statements.text: Thermodynamic irreversibility, decoherence and causal horizons are three regimes in which the accessible fraction $R$ falls while global evolution stays lawful: coarse-graining, loss of accessible phase coherence and restriction of the causally accessible domain.

sources.quote: Thermodynamics therefore reflects changing recoverability conditions rather than failure of lawful evolution itself.
Horizons therefore limit recoverable structure without terminating globally lawful evolution.
